title: kblane.path_lane classes any top-level file kb/<file> as content, not only a submodule root's gitlink
goal: kblane.path_lane classes a plain top-level file directly under the kb directory (a markdown file or the ignore file) as code, and commit_paths reads the raw git mode of each entry and leaves a submodule root's gitlink (mode 160000) out of the paths it returns, so a gitlink change stays content; path_lane keeps its signature path_lane(path) -> str (SP-c6w5hjmc review gap 8; the gate answer of BG-qgulx5sj chose the bare path and this narrows it)

sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
